Description: Show finance teams how accurate and safe the AI agent is and gate go-live on objective checks (projects 02, 05).
One queue for everything automation could not finish, with a reason and a one-click fix (projects 01, 06).
Invoices post to the customer's ERP exactly once, with visible status and clear failures (project 07).

Summary: Weekly quality score for the collections agent
Description:
As a finance manager I want a weekly quality score so that I can decide whether to expand the agent.

Acceptance criteria:
Given 50+ messages were sent, when I open the scorecard, then I see pass rate, critical-defect count and a sample of failed messages.

As a quality reviewer I want defects split by type and whether rules can catch them so that I focus on tone and offers.

Acceptance criteria:
Given a week of messages, when I view defects, then each type shows count, rule-catch rate and a 'needs judge' marker.

As a finance manager I want to choose conservative, balanced or aggressive automation so that I control the risk.

Acceptance criteria:
Given I choose a level, when invoices are processed, then STP rate and false-approve rate for that level are displayed with an explanation.

As an implementation lead I want calling locked until quality thresholds are met so that unsafe agents never contact customers.

Acceptance criteria:
Given the last 500 messages, when critical factual defects > 0 or judge kappa < 0.7, then 'Enable calling' stays disabled and the reason is shown.

As a quality reviewer I want to label flagged messages so that the judge is calibrated against humans.

Acceptance criteria:
Given a flagged message, when I mark it correct or incorrect, then the label is stored and agreement (kappa) is recomputed weekly.

As a customer who disputes an invoice I want to be handed to a person so that I am not pushed to pay.

Acceptance criteria:
Given a dispute phrase in the reply, when the agent responds, then it hands off to a human and logs the event.

As an AP clerk I want one queue of invoices the system could not finish so that nothing falls through.

Acceptance criteria:
Given an invoice fails matching or capture, when I open the inbox, then it appears with type, amount, age and reason.

As an AP clerk I want a suggested fix per exception so that I resolve it quickly.

Acceptance criteria:
Given a price mismatch within policy, when I click 'Accept tolerance', then the invoice moves to approval and the decision is logged.

As a product manager I want each resolution stored as a label so that automation improves over time.

Acceptance criteria:
Given an exception is resolved, when saved, then its type, fix and time-to-resolve are stored for reporting.

As a finance manager I want invalid invoices stopped with a reason so that bad data never reaches the ERP.

Acceptance criteria:
Given lines do not add up to the total, when submitted, then it is rejected with a reason and no ERP call is made.

As a finance manager I want retries never to create duplicates so that the books stay correct.

Acceptance criteria:
Given the same invoice is submitted twice, when posted, then exactly one ERP document exists.

As an integration owner I want transient errors retried and failures alerted so that I can act early.

Acceptance criteria:
Given a timeout, when posting, then retry up to 4 times with backoff; if the failure rate exceeds 2% in an hour, an alert is sent.

As an AP clerk I want to see each invoice's sync status so that I know whether it reached the ERP.

Acceptance criteria:
Given any invoice, when opened, then status, ERP document id and number of attempts are shown.
